name: Martin Pfeiffer

events.place: Przystajnia, Kalisz Powiat, Kalisz Obwód, Kalisz Voivodeship, Congress Poland

notes:
Family History Centre: Refer to LDS copy from film # 764031. This was interpreted by Eva Kurnicka.  The brides parents were Christian Koser but the mother can only be read to be Eva and the last name is unreadable.  Martin Pfeiffer is the son of Christian Pfeiffer and Beata Luise Busch who were farmers of the Pfeiffer family in the village of Pryzanie.
LDS Film #1191424 records the birth of Berta Zellmer (BK person # 1726) and states therein that "Willhelm Zelmer, a day-laborer from Zbirsk, 22 years old, arrived accompanying bywitnesses Martin Schulz, 48 years old-----etc".  The year of birth of Berta Zellmer was Nov. 11, 1870.  By inference then, Martin Schulz who was 48 years old would have been born in 1822 and that date has been used in his record.
